segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Megan. I wanted to confirm the package we discussed for the operations team: 42 standard seats, 6 manager seats, and the implementation support for the first 30 days. Is that still the right count?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's right. We may add two more managers in Q3, but for the initial order it's 48 total seats. Our finance team asked if the quote can show those as separate line items.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Absolutely. I can split standard and manager seats on the quote. Based on the pricing sheet, that puts the annual subscription at $38,640, and implementation is a one-time $4,800. So total first-year is $43,440 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had. On billing, we need annual upfront, net 30, and the invoice has to reference PO 41782. Can your billing tool handle that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I'll add the PO number in the billing notes and on the order form. Net 30 is fine. The invoice would go out after signature unless you want it delayed to the June 3 start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: After signature is fine. We just need the subscription term to run June 3, 2026 through June 2, 2027. Our go-live target is June 17.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I'll set the term dates that way. For go-live on June 17, we'd schedule kickoff the week of June 3, data import by June 10, and admin training on June 12 or 13. Does that work?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: June 12 is better. We have a team offsite on the 13th. Also, can you include one renewal cap in the contract? Legal asked for no more than 5% increase at renewal.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, a 5% renewal cap is within our standard terms. I don't need deal desk for that. I'll include it in the order form and send the updated version by end of day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and copy our contracts alias. If everything looks right, I can get signature routed tomorrow.
